findings.reason: The fixed dictionary label Καφές is nominative. The actual compiled LocalizeItem consumer inserts it after έχω, producing Ορίστε, έχω Καφές. Greek έχω takes an accusative object (καφέ); removing the prior plural predicates did not repair this case mismatch. The proposed colon introduces the unchanged label as an item citation and preserves possession, small quantity and hope of usefulness.
